[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended novels similar to "The Nightingale":

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. "The Lost Girls of Paris" by Pam Jenoff: Follows a young widow discovering a suitcase of photographs of women in a resistance network during WWII.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. "The Women in the Castle" by Jessica Shattuck: Tells the story of three women during WWII and their struggles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. "Those Who Save Us" by Jenna Blum: Explores the relationship between a mother and daughter in Nazi-occupied Germany.
